_note: v1: first full draft, before audit. Reference image 1 = real-time render of the actual 3D car model (front three-quarter). Reference image 2 = the same model from the side. Commercial frames use photo panels because no good open-source van model exists; in the build those panels hold EveryWrap's real job photos.
shared_tail: The car is exactly the car in the reference images: same body shape, proportions, wheels and details, with no badges or logos. It should look like a high-end real-time 3D render (WebGL), clean and crisp, not a photograph. All on-screen text is crisp and correctly spelled. Show only the page itself, edge to edge: no browser window, no device frame, no concept title, no extra captions.

concepts.name: One Light
concepts.idea: Quiet luxury. A black wrap booth, one long light, and the scroll itself wraps the car: a seam of vinyl travels nose to tail as you move through the page.
concepts.signature: Scroll-driven wrap seam (clip-plane reveal between factory paint and the chosen vinyl) with a slow camera orbit; services are numbered chapters on a thin rail.

frames.D-personal: Website hero mockup, desktop 16:9. A pitch-black studio with a glossy black floor. One long rectangular softbox light hangs overhead and a thin vertical light bar stands behind the car at the left. the low, wide mid-engine concept coupe from reference image 1 (long glass canopy, slim slit headlights, large star-spoke wheels, no badges) sits large on the right two-thirds of the frame in a front three-quarter view. A sharp vertical seam crosses the car just behind the front door: everything in front of the seam is wrapped in satin black vinyl with a soft milky sheen, everything behind the seam is still gloss white factory paint. The seam is a thin warm-white glowing line with a slightly lifted film edge. Soft reflection of the car in the floor. Left third: a very large elegant serif headline in bone white, two lines, 'Satin black.' and 'Done right.', with one small line under it: 'Vinyl wrap, installed by hand in Columbus, Ohio.' Far left edge: a thin vertical chapter rail with five small numbered labels stacked: '01 Wrap' (bright, with a short amber tick), '02 Protect', '03 Tint', '04 Kits', '05 Fleet' (dim), and a hairline scroll-progress line beside them. Under the headline: a row of five small round finish dots (satin black selected with a thin amber ring, then gloss black, grey, red, iridescent purple-teal). Top left: small wide-tracked wordmark 'EVERYWRAP'. Top right: a small two-part switch 'PERSONAL | COMMERCIAL' with PERSONAL active. Bottom center: one slim dark input line with a camera icon reading 'Tell me your car…'. Bottom right: one solid bone-white button 'Get my price'. Lots of empty black space. Palette: black, bone white, one amber accent.
frames.M-personal: Website hero mockup, phone portrait 9:16. Same black studio and same single overhead softbox. the low, wide mid-engine concept coupe from reference image 1 (long glass canopy, slim slit headlights, large star-spoke wheels, no badges) fills the upper two-thirds of the screen edge to edge, front three-quarter view, cropped close so it feels big, with the same vertical vinyl seam: satin black in front, gloss white behind. Its reflection fades into the black floor. Overlapping the bottom of the car: a large bone-white serif headline in two lines, 'Satin black.' 'Done right.' Above the headline a tiny label '01 / 05  Wrap' with a short amber tick. Under the headline: five small finish dots in a row, satin black selected. frames.D-commercial: Website hero mockup, desktop 16:9, the commercial theme of the same site. The black booth becomes a bright white seamless studio with soft even light and a pale grey floor; the same long rectangular softbox hangs overhead. On the right two-thirds, three large upright photo panels stand on the floor like gallery light boxes, staggered in depth, each a photograph of a wrapped work vehicle in daylight: a cargo van in a full printed graphic, a box truck, a food truck. Far left edge: a thin chapter rail in navy: '01 Fleet' (active, cobalt tick), '02 Box trucks', '03 Food trucks', '04 Signs'. Top left: wordmark 'EVERYWRAP' in navy. Top right: the switch 'PERSONAL | COMMERCIAL' with COMMERCIAL active in cobalt. Bottom center: one slim white input line with a camera icon reading 'Tell me your fleet…'. Bottom right: one solid cobalt button 'Get my price'. Palette: white, navy, cobalt, a little orange.

concepts.name: Finish Library
concepts.idea: A bright material lab. The finish name is the architecture: giant letters stand behind the car, and the finishes are physical vinyl sample cards you pick up.
concepts.signature: Drag a vinyl sample card onto the car to re-wrap it; the giant word behind the car changes with it.

concepts.name: Light Tunnel
concepts.idea: Motion. The car sits in a tunnel of moving light bars, the way finishes are shown in car films: reflections race over the bodywork and every finish reads instantly.
concepts.signature: Light arches stream past the car continuously; the pointer or the phone's tilt steers them; a gear-style selector switches service with a burst of speed.
